question: Will Binance officially announce more than $2B stolen in the October 29, 2026 attack by Nov 5, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Binance publishes an official statement strictly after 2026-10-29T21:07:47.540Z and at or before 2026-11-05T08:00:00.000Z that explicitly confirms the total amount stolen in the October 29, 2026 attack on Binance exceeds $2,000,000,000 (two billion US dollars).
- "No": Wins if no such official Binance statement confirming more than $2B stolen in the October 29, 2026 attack is published strictly after 2026-10-29T21:07:47.540Z and at or before 2026-11-05T08:00:00.000Z.

Clarifications:
- An "official statement" means a post, press release, blog entry, or public disclosure published on Binance's official website, official blog, or verified official social media accounts (e.g. @Binance on X/Twitter). Third-party estimates, on-chain analyses, or media reports do not qualify; only Binance's own acknowledgment of the loss figure counts.
- The $2B threshold applies to the total stolen amount as stated by Binance, net of any amounts described as recovered or frozen by Binance in the same statement. If Binance's statement gives a range, the lower bound of the range must exceed $2B for "Yes" to win.
